intake.description: Self-assessment of RUGD Intelligence during the October 2026 pilot. Approved pilot scope is this venture and Bunny Hive. This file is an intake for the assessment engine. It is not a final recommendation.

verified_data.evidence_notes: The only sources read for this intake are docs/00-RUGD-Methodology.md, docs/03-Architecture-MVP.md, docs/04-Pilot-Scope.md, and docs/05-Cursor-Rules.md (all Version 1.0, October 2026). Those documents establish the pilot scope and the methodology. They do not state revenue, cash, headcount, prices, costs, or gross margin.

assumptions.rationale: docs/04-Pilot-Scope.md, Approved Pilots. This is evidence of project scope. It is not evidence of customer demand.
docs/04-Pilot-Scope.md Success Criteria still calls for a clear statement of whether pricing and process are viable. No price is stated in /docs.
docs/00-RUGD-Methodology.md Purpose: the methodology must be capable of recommending against a proposed action when evidence does not support proceeding.
No capital amount is stated in /docs. Zero is a placeholder so the engine can run. It is not a measured cash balance. inputs_are_measured is false.
No cost amount is stated in /docs. Zero is a placeholder, not a measured cost.
No gross margin is stated in /docs. Zero means the margin is not established. It is not a measured margin of zero percent in the market.
No revenue forecast is stated in /docs. Pricing viability is still an open pilot question. Zero is a placeholder, not a forecast.
0.6 is the default argument on FinancialInputs in engine/financial.py. It is not a measured downside for this venture.

field_definitions.base_monthly_cash_flow: base_monthly_contribution − monthly_fixed_costs, rounded half-even to cents
field_definitions.downside_monthly_cash_flow: (projected_monthly_revenue_base × downside_revenue_multiplier × gross_margin_pct) − monthly_fixed_costs, rounded half-even to cents
field_definitions.break_even_monthly_revenue: monthly_fixed_costs / gross_margin_pct when gross margin is positive; otherwise undefined (Methodology § Output Requirements)
field_definitions.months_to_break_even_base: initial_capital / unrounded base monthly cash flow when the rounded base cash flow is positive. This is months to recover initial capital at the base cash-flow rate, not a revenue-ramp forecast. Methodology § Output Requirements asks for break-even; that amount is break_even_monthly_revenue.

recommendation.score_note: Not computed. Methodology § Scoring Approach defines the overall feasibility score as a weighted average and says weights are adjustable by engagement type. No weights are approved, and no 1–5 rubric is approved, so none of these dimensions received a score: Market & Demand Reality; Competitive Position & Differentiation; Financial Feasibility & Capital Requirements; Operational Readiness & Capacity; Risk Profile (market, execution, financial, regulatory); Stewardship Indicators (reinvestment capacity, resilience, continuity potential); Implementation Feasibility (for AI or operational improvements).
method_assumptions: Marginal cash flow means monthly cash flow rounded half-even to cents is less than or equal to zero. No other marginal band is approved.
NEGATIVE_OR_MARGINAL_CASH_FLOW is raised only when both the base case and the downside case meet that test.
Any flag in the approved recommend-against set drafts do-not-proceed. No per-flag split between do-not-proceed and conditional-only is approved.
A criterion with no user or verified input stays unevaluated. Unevaluated criteria draft conditional when no recommend-against flag fired, so a silent intake cannot draft go.
Assumptions with source ai_interpretation are listed. They do not raise or clear recommend-against flags.
demand_evidence true with source verified, or verified trailing revenue greater than zero, clears insufficient demand. Trailing revenue of zero does not. Trailing revenue is not a market-size score.
demand_evidence true with source user leaves DEMAND_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED. That gap drafts conditional when no recommend-against flag fired. It does not draft do-not-proceed by itself.
If demand support conflicts with demand_evidence false from a user or verified source, the insufficient-demand flag stays on.
If operator capacity, regulatory exposure, or extraction has both true and false from user or verified sources, the recommend-against flag stays on.

When financial_inputs is present and inputs_are_measured is omitted, the inputs are treated as measured. When the field is false, or financial_inputs is absent, the cash-flow criterion is not evaluated.
months_to_break_even_base is months to recover initial capital at the base cash-flow rate. Break-even revenue is break_even_monthly_revenue.
The overall feasibility score and the 1–5 dimension scores are not computed.
No currency unit is defined on the intake. Amounts stay in the unit of the inputs.
This module cannot record human approval. is_final stays false and human_review_status stays pending.
The report date is the intake as_of_date or the --date argument. The runner does not read the system clock.
Intake checks cover the fields this pilot uses. A full JSON Schema draft-2020-12 library is not a project dependency.
Output files are written only under the project root.

monthly_fixed_costs = 0. No cost amount is stated in /docs. Zero is a placeholder, not a measured cost.
gross_margin_pct = 0. No gross margin is stated in /docs. Zero means the margin is not established. It is not a measured margin of zero percent in the market.
projected_monthly_revenue_base = 0. No revenue forecast is stated in /docs. Pricing viability is still an open pilot question. Zero is a placeholder, not a forecast.
downside_revenue_multiplier = 0.6. 0.6 is the default argument on FinancialInputs in engine/financial.py. It is not a measured downside for this venture.
next_actions: Human reviewer must approve or reject this draft before it is used as a recommendation. This runner cannot record that approval.
Stop. Do not proceed on this evidence. Methodology § Output Requirements includes stop as a valid next action.
Gather verified demand evidence and record it as verified trailing revenue above zero, or as demand_evidence true with source verified. Re-run before reconsideration.
Replace unmeasured financial inputs with measured figures, set inputs_are_measured to true, and re-run.
Record operator_capacity_adequate as true or false with source user or verified.
Record unresolved_regulatory_or_liability as true or false with source user or verified.
Record extraction_without_reinvestment as true or false with source user or verified.
